content.short: Angle is a DeFi stablecoin lending protocol powered by its own stablecoin, agEUR.
content.description: Angle, launched in 2021, is a decentralized, over-collateralized stablecoin protocol that emphasizes capital efficiency. It issues agEUR, a stablecoin designed to track the value of the asset it backs, allowing users to engage with crypto markets without exposing themselves to volatility. Developers have access to the protocol's documentation to facilitate integration and exploration on supported networks.
